Common Tasks

Quick reference for things you'll do regularly.

Force-search for a specific episode

  1. Open the series → click the season to expand episodes
  2. Click the search icon next to the episode
  3. NGMS queries all configured indexers immediately and grabs the best matching release
ℹ
Force search ignores the RSS cache and always hits the indexer APIs directly. Use it sparingly — excessive API calls may rate-limit your indexer account.

Interactive search (pick a specific release)

  1. Episode or movie → Manual Search (magnifying glass icon)
  2. NGMS shows all matching releases with quality, size, indexer, and custom format score
  3. Click Grab on the release you want

Blocklist a release

If a grabbed release is corrupt, wrong, or otherwise unusable:

  1. Open Queue or History
  2. Find the item → click Blocklist (with or without deleting the file)
  3. NGMS adds the release title to the blocklist so it's never grabbed again
  4. Optionally trigger a new search immediately

Manually import a file

  1. Go to Import page (or the series detail Import tab)
  2. Navigate to the file or directory
  3. Verify the detected match and quality, correct if needed
  4. Click Import

View real-time logs

  1. Go to System → Logs
  2. Logs stream in real-time via SSE — no page refresh needed
  3. Use the log level filter to reduce noise (Info is usually enough)
  4. For deeper debugging, set STACKARR_LOG_LEVEL=debug in your environment and restart

Trigger a scheduler task manually

Background tasks (RSS sync, metadata refresh, import scan, Plex sync) run on a schedule, but can be triggered immediately:

  1. System → Tasks
  2. Find the task and click Run Now

Reset an API key

  1. Settings → General
  2. Click Regenerate API Key
  3. Update any external apps or scripts that use the old key

Check system health

NGMS runs health checks continuously. If something is wrong (indexer unreachable, root folder missing, download client offline) a warning banner appears in the UI.

  1. System → Status for a full health report
  2. Each warning links to the relevant settings page to fix it

Rename existing files after changing a naming template

  1. Change the naming template in Settings → Media Management
  2. Go to Series or Movies list
  3. Select all → Rename Files (bulk action)
  4. Preview the changes and confirm
